target_concept: Trace the nested loops that iterate over character positions and strings, and explain the early break when a mismatch occurs.

mcq.questionText: According to the described algorithm, at which point does the execution break out of the loops?
options: When the set size equals one, indicating all characters match
When the set size is not one, indicating a mismatch
After the outer loop has processed all character positions
When the inner loop finishes scanning a single string
mcq.correctAnswer: When the set size is not one, indicating a mismatch
mcq.explanation: The evidence states that "If the size is not one, we break out" and later clarifies that a break occurs when characters differ. Therefore the break is triggered when the hash set size is not one, meaning the current characters across the strings do not all match.
